subject: prd/implement-now
statement: When direct issue entry is selected, the executor shall verify the tracker instance, repository or Carina root, issue identity, open executable state, and every native dependency's readiness through exact reads; it shall repair, claim, implement, or review only that issue and obligations belonging to its admitted contract. Read-only exact source-comment and native-dependency facts, plus shared metadata/index reads needed to select that scope, are permitted; unrelated proposal/artifact lookups are prohibited. An unreadable or open blocker shall block entry even when outside the selected set or agent label.
rationale: filtering a label frontier can launch unrelated work or mistake an omitted blocker for completed work
fit_criterion: same-number cross-provider/repository issues, pull requests, closed items, Carina rollups, missing items, open/unreadable blockers, unrelated malformed task capsules, and unrelated review obligations produce zero unauthorized launches or repairs; ready exact selection works without an agent label
